description.value:
The G-58 Dian is one of the top smartguns on the market today. You can spot it in use among even the most elite units, including the Trauma Team. And no wonder! When you're pulling a victim out of the Combat Zone, every millisec counts – there's no time to set up your shot, take a deep breath and ready, aim, fire! You just need your lead to hit home. The G-58 Dian recognizes your target and aims right for it, all automatically. You can be sure even a quick, distracted shot will land right where it should. What's more, the fully automated reloading system, ultra-sensitive radar and top-of-the-line holographic sight make shoot-em-ups a breeze.

Cost: 2,500eb (Very Expensive)

Class: Excellent Quality Heavy SMG • Skill: Handgun • Range: SMG

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: 45 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (SMG 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No (While unfolded)

Slots: 0 • Attachments: Autoloader, Smart Rebuild, SMG Cyclic Internals (SMG 4) • Mods: None

Special Features: As an Action, this weapon can be folded/unfolded. While folded, this weap on is concealable but cannot fire. Incompatible with Folding Structure. While the weapon’s magazine is empty, the user may expend their Move Action to Reload it without an Action [Autoloader]. The Autoloader is then considered empty, and cannot be used again until until an Action is used to reset it.

Range: SMG
Pre-installed: Autoloader, Smart Rebuild, SMG Cyclic Internals (SMG 4) (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (SMG 4), Suppressive Fire

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
